user_feedback_incorporated: Observed external gaming mouse direct-capture friction during live run because 03 patch nulled window.toolbar and did not auto-capture on fullscreen entry / canvas click

Updated 03-clean-fullscreen-game-shell.patch to preserve toolbar object (isVisible=false only), auto-capture on fullscreen entry and canvas click in Game Shell / pure-relative mode, and tighten gameShellHasStarted to state == .started; rebuilt and re-verified UTM-Custom.app

resolution_scaling_elasticity.bottleneck_diagnosis: CPU/Prism x86_64 translation + 6-vCPU scheduling + QEMU slirp networking dominate steady-state frame ceiling (~55-64 FPS); Apple Silicon GPU + dxmt-native render server uses only 33-45% CPU and is NOT pixel-fill bound even at 1920x1200.

key_findings: 19/39 critical FPS drops (<5 FPS) in RangeV2 occurred while opening/closing in-game Settings/Pause menus (LogLandingScreen / WBP_Screen_Settings), NOT during combat.
5/39 occurred during the first 30 seconds of RangeV2 map loading.

Runtime shader/material PSO compilation (1301 PSO creations in NPEV2, DXMT shader cache growing to 8.85 MiB) caused early-to-mid session micro-stutters, which dropped to 0 critical drops in Minute 8 once warmed up (55.51 mean FPS, P50 58.44 FPS, P5 42.42 FPS, P1 25.74 FPS).
QEMU user-mode slirp NAT (required by ad-hoc signing lacking com.apple.vm.networking entitlement) triggered 7 Ping >200ms alerts and 128-tick UDP Burst Loss / 256-packet ack backlogs.
Unrelated background guest service spice-webdavd.exe crashed once (0x80000003) because shared folder channel was trimmed; safe candidate to disable in guest-optimizer v3.

note_on_non_ace_events: System Event 7030 (interactive service warning for AntiCheatExpert Protection) was benign and did not prevent ACE kernel drivers or 154 HTTP 200 ticks.
System Event 7000 for unrelated Windows luafv appeared only on subsequent reboot; 0 ACE 7000/1275 events occurred.
